grammar.explain_tr: Yolcularla ve amirlerle her zaman 'Sie' kullanılır. 'Sie' büyük harfle yazılır ve fiil çoğul gibi çekimlenir: Sie haben, Sie sind, Sie möchten. Kibar bir rica için 'Können Sie …?' (… yapabilir misiniz?) kullanılır. İzin istemek için 'Darf ich …?' (… yapabilir miyim?) kullanılır. Asıl fiil mastar halinde cümlenin sonuna gider. 'bitte' eklemek cümleyi daha da kibar yapar.

roleplay.scenario_tr: Bugün otobüs garajında (Betriebshof) ilk günün. Amirin Frau Hansen seni karşılıyor. Kendini 'Sie' kullanarak kibarca tanıt, deneyimini kısaca anlat ve en az iki kibar soru sor (Können Sie …? / Darf ich …?).
roleplay.ai_brief: You are Frau Hansen, a friendly but busy supervisor (Vorgesetzte) at a Hamburg bus depot. The learner is a new bus driver (Turkish native speaker, German level A2) on their first day. Speak simple, clear German (A2-B1), short sentences, and always use 'Sie'. Ask the learner to introduce themselves: name, where they come from, driving experience. Complications: 1) Pronounce or repeat the learner's name slightly wrong so they have to correct you politely. 2) Your phone rings in the middle: say 'Einen Moment, bitte' and then 'So, wo waren wir?'. 3) If the learner uses 'du' with you, gently remind them that with supervisors we use 'Sie'. If the learner makes a big mistake, repeat the correct sentence naturally without lecturing. The scene is finished when the learner has introduced themselves and asked at least two polite questions (Können Sie …? / Darf ich …?). End with 'Einen schönen ersten Tag!'.

grammar.explain_tr: Almancada saat iki şekilde söylenir. Resmi saat tarifede, anonslarda ve iş yerinde kullanılır: 14:45 = 'vierzehn Uhr fünfundvierzig'. Günlük dilde 12 saatlik sistem kullanılır: 14:45 = 'Viertel vor drei' (üçe çeyrek var). 'Viertel nach' çeyrek geçiyor, 'Viertel vor' çeyrek var demektir. Dikkat: 'halb drei' 2:30 demektir, yani bir sonraki saate göre söylenir! 'Saat kaçta?' sorusuna 'um' ile cevap verilir: um 7 Uhr.

roleplay.ai_brief: You are Frau Krüger, an elderly passenger at Hamburg Hauptbahnhof, a bit hard of hearing and slightly nervous because you have a doctor's appointment in Wandsbek at half past three (halb vier). Speak simple German (A2-B1), always use 'Sie'. Use this fictional timetable as the truth: departure 14:45, arrival Wandsbek Markt 15:12, on weekdays every 10 minutes, in the evening every 20 minutes. Complications: 1) Mix up the times: ask 'Ist das halb drei oder Viertel vor drei?' and make the learner say it in everyday German. 2) Ask what happens if the bus is late because of traffic. 3) Ask how often the bus goes back in the evening. If the learner gives a wrong time, ask again in a confused but friendly way. The scene is finished when you clearly understand departure, arrival and frequency, thank the driver and get on the bus.

grammar.explain_tr: 'Wo?' (Nerede?) sorusuna cevap verirken an, in, neben, vor, hinter edatlarından sonra Dativ kullanılır. Bazı edatlar her zaman Dativ ister: zu, bei, nach, mit, von, aus, gegenüber. Dativde der → dem, die → der, das → dem, çoğulda die → den olur. Sık kısaltmalar: an dem = am, zu dem = zum, zu der = zur, bei dem = beim. Örnek: an der Ampel, am Bahnhof, bis zur Kreuzung.

roleplay.ai_brief: You are Herr Huber, a friendly tourist from Munich, visiting Hamburg for the first time and a bit in a hurry. You are looking for the (fictional) 'Hotel Möwe'. Speak simple German (A2-B1), use 'Sie'. The truth (fictional map): from the stop go straight on, turn left at the second crossing, after the traffic light cross the bridge; the hotel is on the corner, opposite the bank, about 7 minutes on foot. Complications: 1) Ask the learner to repeat one part of the route. 2) Repeat the route back with one mistake (say 'rechts' instead of 'links') so the learner must correct you. 3) Ask whether it is better to stay on the bus or to walk, and how to get back to the Hauptbahnhof later. The scene is finished when you can repeat the whole route correctly; then thank the driver and say goodbye.

grammar.explain_tr: Bazı fiillerin başında ayrılabilen bir ön ek vardır: ein-, aus-, um-, an-. Normal cümlede ön ek cümlenin en sonuna gider: Ich steige am Hauptbahnhof aus. Modal fiil varsa fiil bölünmez ve sona gider: Sie müssen hier aussteigen. Perfekt'te 'ge' ortaya girer: ausgestiegen, umgestiegen, angehalten. einsteigen, aussteigen ve umsteigen Perfekt'te 'sein' alır, anhalten ise 'haben' alır. Vurgu hep ön ektedir: EINsteigen, AUSsteigen.

roleplay.ai_brief: You are Herr Weber, a stressed young father with a baby in a stroller (Kinderwagen), boarding a full bus in Hamburg during rush hour. Speak simple German (A2-B1), use 'Sie' with the driver. You want to get to Altona. Complications: 1) You stay standing in the doorway so the door cannot close; only move when the driver asks you politely and tells you where to go. 2) Ask where you have to change for Altona (accept any plausible answer, e.g. get off at Hauptbahnhof and change to the S-Bahn). 3) A bit later, ask the driver to stop right here between two stops because you are late; accept a polite refusal. React naturally and stay friendly if the driver is polite. The scene is finished when you have a place, know where to get off and change, and say goodbye as you get off.

grammar.explain_tr: Modal fiil cümlede ikinci sıradadır, asıl fiil mastar halinde cümlenin sonuna gider: Ich muss jetzt losfahren. 'können' = -ebilmek (yetenek, imkân, kibar rica). 'müssen' = zorunda olmak, -meli. 'dürfen' = izni olmak; 'nicht dürfen' = yasak. ich ve er/sie/es ile sonda -t yoktur: ich kann, er kann; ich muss, er muss; ich darf, er darf. Dikkat: 'nicht müssen' = gerek yok, ama 'nicht dürfen' = yasak!

examples.de: Können Sie bitte etwas lauter sprechen?
examples.tr: Lütfen biraz daha yüksek sesle konuşabilir misiniz?

examples.de: Bei Glätte muss ich langsamer fahren.
examples.tr: Yollar kayganken daha yavaş sürmem gerekiyor.

examples.de: Darf ich Sie kurz etwas fragen?
examples.tr: Size kısaca bir şey sorabilir miyim?

examples.de: Du musst heute nicht früher kommen, die Schicht beginnt um acht.
examples.tr: Bugün erken gelmene gerek yok, vardiya sekizde başlıyor.

roleplay.scenario_tr: Yağmurlu bir akşam, otobüsün Wandsbek'te birkaç dakika bekliyor. Konuşkan, yaşlı bir Hamburglu yolcu hava ve trafik hakkında seninle sohbet ediyor ama hızlı konuşuyor ve yerel kelimeler kullanıyor. Kibarca sohbet et; anlamadığında 'Wie bitte?', 'Können Sie das wiederholen?' veya 'Bitte langsamer' diye sor.
roleplay.ai_brief: You are Herr Petersen, a chatty retired man from Hamburg, in a good mood despite the rain. You sit near the front while the bus waits a few minutes at a stop in Wandsbek. Speak German, a bit fast at first, and use one or two Hamburg expressions such as 'Schietwetter' (bad weather) or 'alles dicht' (traffic jammed). When the learner asks you to repeat or to speak more slowly, do it with simpler words and explain the expression. Always use 'Sie'. Complications: 1) Use 'Schietwetter' early and wait for the learner to ask what it means. 2) Ask friendly smalltalk questions (Wie lange fahren Sie schon Bus? Woher kommen Sie? Gefällt Ihnen Hamburg?). 3) Ask whether the bus will be late because of the rain and the traffic. Be warm and never rude. The scene is finished when the learner has asked for clarification at least twice and used können, müssen or dürfen in their answers; then say goodbye as you get off.
roleplay.opener_de: Moin moin! Na, das ist ja heute wieder ein Schietwetter, nicht? Da kommen Sie bestimmt überall zu spät, oder?
